literal_meaning: কথার শিল্পী (story artist or artist of words)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সমরেশ বসু বাংলা সাহিত্যের প্রখ্যাত কথাশিল্পী হিসেবে পরিচিত।
example_sentences_in_english: Rabindranath Tagore is an extraordinary novelist.
Satyajit Ray is known as a renowned fiction writer in Bengali literature.
note: This is a compound term used in literary contexts rather than a traditional proverbial idiom.
